name: Watershed Security Fund Grants Program (B.C.)
summary: British Columbia grants in three streams (up to $50,000, $150,000 or $400,000) for community-led watershed work, including ecosystem restoration, monitoring and nature-based infrastructure, in numbered application intakes.

amount.note: Three streams with maximums of $50,000, $150,000 and $400,000

steps: Application submission (portal, Word document or support call)

eligibility.rule: No individual benefits, debt, reserves, retroactive costs, land/building purchases, endowments or partisan politics
One application per organisation per intake, in one funding stream

documents: Budget form for Stream 2 and Stream 3 applications

status.quote: Please coordinate the time with our team well in advance so that we can schedule the call, review, and finalize the application content before the November 10, 2026 deadline.

opens.quote: The fourth round of grant applications is open from October 5 to November 10, 2026.

deadline.quote: Please coordinate the time with our team well in advance so that we can schedule the call, review, and finalize the application content before the November 10, 2026 deadline.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible organizations for WSF grant funding include First Nations and non-First Nations organizations in any of these categories: Registered Non-profit Educational Institution Social Enterprise (C3) And: First Nation (including First Nation governments, Tribal Councils and others) Local/Regional Government

geography.quote: supporting watershed work and partnerships in all regions of British Columbia

access.quote: The online portal enables our Grants Program team to process applications more efficiently.

window.quote: The fourth round of grant applications is open from October 5 to November 10, 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: The WSF does not require matching funds, as this has been identified as a barrier for many organizations doing watershed work.

consortium_required.quote: Partners are not a requirement of funding

effort.quote: There are three ways to submit an application:

eligibility.quote: Activities that primarily provide financial benefits for individuals Debt retirement, reserves, mortgage paydowns Retroactive expenses (costs incurred prior to funding being approved) Purchase of land or large-scale development of buildings Endowments Partisan political activities
Organizations are eligible to make one project application per intake in one of the three funding streams.

after_award.quote: Depending on the duration of the project, there will be an interim and final report required.

documents.quote: For applications in Stream 2 (up to $150,000) and Stream 3 (up to $400,000) please submit our budget form with your application.
